title: The Iron-Bond of the Dragontail
summary: End a ruthless conspiracy in the Dragontail Mountains where corrupt ore-factors and Devilrock fire-witches enslave debt-miners to forge illicit weapons in the volcanic tubes of Shedungent.

npcs.name: Justiciar Malik of Rihad
npcs.greet: Look north to the Dragontail peaks, traveller—black furnace-smoke rises from passes where no legal smelter has burned in twenty years.
talk: In Rihad and Taneth, Crown and Forebear merchants alike buy Dragontail iron, asking no questions about how the ore is dug.
Three hundred indentured miners from Tigonus vanished when their debt-contracts were bought by Overseer Jabir. Travel to Tigonus and speak with Foreman Tariq.

npcs.name: Foreman Tariq
npcs.greet: Show me your hands—good, no factor's ink on your fingers. Only an honest blade is welcome in Tigonus tonight.
talk: Overseer Jabir collapsed the legal adits to trap our union speakers, then marched the bound miners up to the lava-tubes near Pothago and Shedungent.
He has struck a fire-pact with the Devilrock Coven at Wether's Cleft to temper contraband blades in volcanic brimstone!

npcs.name: Warden Ayesha of Arkay
npcs.greet: Arkay's law forbids binding a debtor's soul after his body fails in the shaft—yet the Devilrock witches are doing worse.
talk: Cinder-Hag Zora guards the slag-chain at Shedungent's outer gate, using flame-wards to keep the miners penned in the lava-tubes.
Break Zora's ward and confront Overseer Jabir inside Shedungent!

npcs.name: Captain Jalil of the Border-Watch
npcs.greet: My border-rangers trailed the contraband weapon-wagons right to the gates of Shedungent!
talk: Overseer Jabir is selling his brimstone-forged steel to both warlords and bandits across the Cyrodiil border.
We'll free the miners from the galleries while you settle accounts with Jabir at the great anvil!

story_dt_tigonus_shaft: Foreman Tariq: Look at the ankle-shackles left by the collapsed shaft—stamped with Overseer Jabir's mark and blackened with volcanic sulfur.
Justiciar Malik of Rihad: Sulfur from the high lava-tubes above Pothago. He's working the debt-miners in an unlicensed volcanic forge!
Foreman Tariq: Follow the slag-trail past Wether's Cleft to Pothago and Shedungent!
story_dt_pothago_kiln: Cinder-Hag Zora: The mountain's fire hungers for sweat and iron! No miner leaves the lava-tubes while our kilns burn!
Warden Ayesha of Arkay: Extinguish her brimstone brazier and free the chain-gang!
story_dt_shedungent_forge: Overseer Jabir: Crown, Forebear, bandit, or rebel—every hand in Hammerfell buys my Dragontail steel when the war-drums beat!
Captain Jalil of the Border-Watch: Built on stolen lives and witch-fire, Jabir! Your ledger closes today!

quests.title: Black Smoke Over Tigonus
quests.summary: Travel from Rihad to Tigonus and inspect the collapsed mine-shaft with Foreman Tariq.
intro: Three hundred debt-miners have vanished from the Dragontail shafts while unlicensed furnace-smoke rises from the high passes.
Speak with Justiciar Malik in Rihad and travel north to Tigonus to question Foreman Tariq.
complete: Sulfur-blackened shackles at Tigonus proved that Overseer Jabir marched the miners to the volcanic tubes near Pothago and Shedungent.

journal.start: Justiciar Malik in Rihad sent me to Tigonus to investigate the disappearance of three hundred debt-miners.
journal.done: Foreman Tariq showed me sulfur-stained shackles pointing toward Pothago and Shedungent.

quests.title: Brimstone at Pothago
quests.summary: Cross Wether's Cleft, meet Warden Ayesha in Pothago, and defeat Cinder-Hag Zora of the Devilrock Coven.
intro: Overseer Jabir has allied with the Devilrock Coven to guard the outer slag-kilns at Pothago.
Scout Wether's Cleft, speak with Warden Ayesha in Pothago, and slay Cinder-Hag Zora.
complete: With Cinder-Hag Zora defeated, the outer chain-gangs at Pothago were freed and pointed you toward the fortress-foundry of Shedungent.

journal.start: I must pass Wether's Cleft, meet Warden Ayesha in Pothago, and defeat Cinder-Hag Zora.
journal.done: I slew Cinder-Hag Zora at Pothago and broke the flame-ward sealing the road to Shedungent.

quests.title: The Lava-Tubes of Shedungent
quests.summary: Check the caravan staging-post at Mournoth and join Captain Jalil outside Shedungent.
intro: Before assaulting Shedungent, seize the contraband weapon manifests at Mournoth and rally with Captain Jalil at Shedungent's gate.
Visit Mournoth and speak with Captain Jalil at Shedungent.
complete: Captain Jalil's border-rangers breached the outer gates of Shedungent to liberate the captive miners.

journal.start: I must check the smuggling manifests at Mournoth and meet Captain Jalil at Shedungent.
journal.done: Captain Jalil and I breached the outer defenses of Shedungent.

quests.title: Breaking the Iron-Bond
quests.summary: Storm the volcanic foundry of Shedungent, defeat Overseer Jabir, and return the burned debt-ledgers to Justiciar Malik in Rihad.
intro: Inside Shedungent, Overseer Jabir guards the iron-chests containing the miners' indentures and his contraband war-blade stockpiles.
Defeat Overseer Jabir in Shedungent and report the liberation of the miners to Justiciar Malik in Rihad.
complete: Overseer Jabir is dead, the unlawful debt-ledgers have been cast into the volcanic fissures, and the freed miners have returned to Tigonus.

journal.start: I must defeat Overseer Jabir inside Shedungent and report back to Justiciar Malik in Rihad.
journal.done: I slew Overseer Jabir in Shedungent and freed the debt-miners of the Dragontail Mountains.
